decision: Strengthen validation, import atomicity, rendering contracts, accessibility behavior, local serving, adapter honesty, and runtime reuse before adding more effect volume.
truthBoundaries: The web adapter is the implemented visual runtime.
Static SVG is an explicit approximation and cannot preserve interaction.
Godot and Unity outputs are token/theme bridges, not native renderer plugins.
The generic game route is a resolved intent contract, not engine parity.
Class-based effects aimed at one DOM target still share that target's CSS state; v1.3 adds target roles but not a per-instance render graph.
Package integrity proves file consistency, not ownership, consent, or redistribution rights.
